evals.name: export-collection-json
evals.prompt: Export the items of my Zotero collection with key SS5MVVB6 to a JSON file, including each item's title, date, tags and type.
evals.expected_output: A JSON file with the 8 items of the collection, each with title/date/tags/type. Read-only; no attempt to POST to the read-only API.
assertions: Produced an actual JSON file (did not just dump the export into chat)
The JSON contains the 8 items of collection SS5MVVB6
Each item entry includes title, date, tags and type fields
Did not attempt to write through the read-only local HTTP API (used the read API or zot exec)

evals.name: tag-noabstract-in-collection
evals.prompt: In my Zotero library, add the tag #revisar to the items in the collection with key SS5MVVB6 that don't have an abstract. Before changing anything, show me how many there are and a couple of example titles.
evals.expected_output: Reports the count + sample of abstract-less items in SS5MVVB6 first (dry-run), then applies #revisar to exactly those items. Scoped to SS5MVVB6, not the whole library.
assertions: Reported the count and example titles BEFORE applying any tag (dry-run first)
Detected missing abstracts reliably (filtering on getField('abstractNote'), not the empty-string search condition which returns 0)
Applied #revisar only to items in collection SS5MVVB6 that lack an abstract (did not tag the whole library)
Acknowledged the safe workflow for writes (backup / sync / test-small / dry-run)

evals.name: subcollection-move-recent
evals.prompt: Create a subcollection called 'Borradores' under my collection with key SS5MVVB6, and move my 2 most recently added items into it.
evals.expected_output: A new collection 'Borradores' with parent SS5MVVB6, containing the 2 most recently added library items. Reports the new key and confirms the move.
assertions: Set its parent to collection SS5MVVB6 (it is a subcollection, not top-level)
Added the 2 most recently added items (by dateAdded) into 'Borradores'
Confirmed the result, reporting the new collection key and the items moved
